hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: AI Image Generation
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: AI Video Generation
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width single-panel hero with brand/logo at top, large left-aligned headline stack, supporting subtext beneath, and a compact benefit list directly under the copy. Primary conversion is embedded in the hero flow rather than isolated below the fold.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Intro hero band followed by a lead-capture form card, then stacked content blocks with simple vertical flow. The page favors clear section breaks over dense multi-column storytelling, with one dominant CTA path and minimal distraction.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple rectangular cards with light borders or subtle shadow, generous internal padding, and strong content hierarchy. Functional over decorative; cards are used for forms and feature lists rather than immersive visual treatment.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA appears as a prominent action in the hero and repeats as a section-level CTA in product blocks. CTA hierarchy is straightforward: one main conversion action, occasional secondary support actions, no persistent sticky CTA observed.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No visible pricing module pattern in the provided reference; pricing should be treated as absent or deferred. If added, it should follow the same simple lead-gen card style rather than a comparison-heavy table.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer pattern not present in the reference snippet; assume minimal or standard utility footer only, with no promotional complexity.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage in the reference snippet, with logo placement in hero and no prominent product imagery. Where media exists, it should be secondary to typography and form capture.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Stacked product feature sections with a label, headline, descriptive paragraph, and a compact bullet feature list. Each section acts as a self-contained explainer with optional CTA, optimized for progressive disclosure rather than tabbed comparison.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form presented as a prominent card directly below the hero. Form fields are vertically stacked, with hidden metadata inputs and a clear heading; the form is designed for short friction and direct conversion.
referenceMap.animationStyle: No evident motion system in the reference; keep interactions static or very subtle, with emphasis on readability and form completion.
designNotes: Prioritize conversion-first hierarchy with one primary CTA path.
Use clear typography contrast and concise supporting bullets.
Keep sections modular and easy to scan.
Avoid heavy visual effects, complex navigation, or comparison UI.
Maintain generous whitespace and strong vertical rhythm.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative teams producing premium visual content
personality.reasoning: This is an AI visual creation product, but the recent cinematic-ai pattern must be avoided. To keep the page fresh while still premium, the visual direction shifts to an operational-dashboard-inspired AI workspace: structured, intelligent, and enterprise-ready. The brand colors are fixed by Techjockey, so the design uses the provided orange-led identity as the primary background and CTA color, with clean neutral support tones. The result feels like a high-end creative control room rather than a generic purple AI splash page.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and descriptive, so a 56px hero size keeps it premium while preserving readability and preventing awkward wrapping.

colours.colourReason: The palette is derived exclusively from the provided Techjockey brand colors. Orange (#ff6b00) becomes the hero background and primary CTA color, white is used for clarity, dark charcoal anchors the typography, and light grey supports section separation.

layout.heroBackground: #ff6b00 with layered dashboard mockup and floating spec chips
layout.heroReason: A full-bleed hero creates strong impact without relying on a split-left pattern, which was recently used. The orange brand hero makes the page unmistakably Techjockey while the overlayed AI workspace visuals communicate product sophistication.
layout.featureReason: Tabbed features are ideal for separating image generation and video generation into distinct product narratives, while avoiding the previously used spotlight-plus-grid style. It also suits a product with multiple model capabilities and detailed sub-features.
layout.darkSectionFor: A narrow proof or capability strip can use dark charcoal panels to create contrast against the orange hero and light feature sections.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a premium AI workspace visual: layered model panels, prompt-to-output pipeline, image and video preview frames, small spec chips, and performance metrics. Keep all product visuals as clean PNG UI composites with subtle depth, while the hero itself can use a JPEG-style rendered composition. Avoid generic sci-fi elements; instead show a creative production interface with professional controls and real workflow cues.
personality.designPersonality: A premium creative operations console: confident, structured, and visually intelligent. It blends brand-led warmth with enterprise clarity, using orange as a bold anchor, layered panels for depth, tabbed product storytelling for complexity, and subtle motion to make the page feel like a modern AI studio for serious teams.

designIntent.audience: Professionals and teams creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate whether ByteDance's generative models can produce premium-quality AI images and videos for professional creative workflows, and request a demo or quote if the capability feels credible.

brandDirection.tone: Expert, premium, and capability-led with a clear B2B buying tone. The page should feel technically credible without becoming overly academic.
brandDirection.visualStyle: Clean, structured, and product-forward with a strong hero, modular feature cards, and clear comparison between image and video capabilities. Use a light, enterprise-friendly layout with subtle depth and minimal decoration.

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the product proposition immediately: two ByteDance generative models for professional AI image and video creation, with a strong primary conversion path.
Explain the two product pillars separately so users can quickly understand Seedream 4.5 for image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for video generation.
Provide commercial anchoring and purchase-readiness for each model, even if one plan is quote-led and the other has a starting price.
Reinforce credibility through role-based testimonials that reflect creative and marketing use cases.

componentNeeds.variantHint: full-width single-panel, brand-led, no image dependency, left-aligned copy stack
componentNeeds.notes: Use a high-contrast hero with a primary brand color background and white text. Include headline, subheadline, supporting line, and a prominent primary CTA. Keep the value proposition concise and enterprise-oriented.
Surface 2-3 quick proof points around text prompts, images, scripts, multimodal generation, and professional output quality.

componentNeeds.variantHint: two stacked product blocks, each with a 5-item feature grid
componentNeeds.notes: Seedream 4.5 should use a 3-column grid on desktop for five features, with simple cards and no decorative icons unless available. Seedance 1.5 Pro should mirror the same structure for consistency.
Seedream should keep its Request Demo CTA; Seedance has no explicit CTA in the source, so use a neutral section CTA pattern only if needed, otherwise keep it informational to avoid inventing intent.

componentNeeds.variantHint: two separate elevated cards with clear comparison hierarchy
componentNeeds.notes: Present pricing as quote-oriented and starting-price-oriented without forcing parity. Seedream remains quote-led; Seedance can show the starting price clearly. Include checklist-style inclusions.
Use role-forward testimonial cards with star rating treatment, italic quote, bold author name, and muted designation. Prioritize creative roles for relevance.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a strong above-the-fold hero with dense value messaging but a simple hierarchy. Since there is no product image or UI screenshot, keep the hero text-first with a bold background, clear CTA hierarchy, and a compact benefit list directly under the copy.
layoutStrategy.features: Organize product sections as vertically stacked modules with consistent heading treatment. Within each module, use a clean card grid that scales to 3 columns on desktop and collapses to 1 column on mobile. Keep the Seedream and Seedance blocks visually parallel so users can compare image vs video capabilities quickly.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials as the main trust layer since no formal badges, social proof counters, or awards are provided. Keep proof role-specific and practical, with light card styling and strong readability.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use pricing cards as a confidence-building section rather than a hard sell. Make the Seedance starting price visually prominent, while keeping Seedream quote-based to avoid implying a fixed rate not provided in the input.
layoutStrategy.form: No lead form should be introduced because includeForm is false. Conversion should be driven through CTA buttons and contact/demo request actions.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use the default Techjockey direction for a premium B2B AI product: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body. Favor a high-trust, enterprise-clean palette with a strong primary color hero treatment, white feature cards, and subtle shadows. Keep motion minimal and use only restrained hover elevation on cards and CTAs.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a single-product, lead-generation landing page with a high-impact hero, two clearly separated product capability sections, pricing cards, and role-based testimonials. Keep the page structured, modular, and trust-led. Avoid forms and avoid over-decoration; let clarity, hierarchy, and card-based content architecture do the work.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: marketing / default hybrid: use Sora for headings and Inter for body, with a strong branded hero in warm purple and orange CTA accents, tailored for high-trust B2B AI creative tools.

sections.variantHint: full-width single-panel hero, left-aligned copy stack, compact benefit list, dual CTA row
sections.contentSource: contentMap.hero + referenceMap.heroPattern + design memory hero rules
sections.notes: Use a strong branded hero background in the primary emotion palette for marketing/productivity. Left column holds headline, subheadline, supporting line, benefit list, and CTA row. Keep conversion in the hero flow. Secondary CTA is empty in content, so only render primary CTA and preserve spacing for consistency if the CTA component supports a single-action state.

sections.variantHint: text-led product block with intro copy and 5-feature grid
sections.notes: Treat as the first product capability section. Include label, headline, description, section CTA, then a 3-column features grid because there are 5 features. Use standard feature cards with borders and 24px padding. Keep the CTA at section end. No media needed.

sections.variantHint: text-led product block with intro copy and 5-feature grid
sections.notes: Second product capability section. Mirror the Seedream section structure for rhythm and consistency. Since there are 5 features, use the same 3-column feature grid and consistent card system. No CTA provided in content, so render content only and preserve spacing alignment with prior section.

sections.variantHint: 2-up pricing cards with quote CTA states
sections.notes: Use a 2-card row. The pricing section should remain functional and quote-oriented. For Seedream, since no price is provided, display quote-led pricing card with included checklist and Get Quote CTA. For Seedance, show starting price, include list, and Get Quote CTA. If original price and discount are absent, omit them rather than inventing values. Maintain a light grey section background and elevated white cards.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with accent left border and star rating
sections.notes: Use 3-column grid on desktop. Include gold star row, italic quote, bold author, and grey designation/company. There are 5 testimonials, so render as a 3+2 grid or a 3-column wrap depending on the component system. Keep card style simple and consistent.

The input news array is empty, so only include this section if the page system requires it as a placeholder shell. Otherwise omit at implementation time. If kept, build as a thin horizontal publication strip with title and subtitle but no items. Prefer omission for strict content fidelity.

sections.variantHint: stacked hero, copy first, CTA full-width
sections.notes: On mobile, stack content vertically. Since no media is specified, keep text-only hero with headline, subheadline, supporting line, and primary CTA full-width. Preserve strong background branding and clear spacing. Keep benefit list compact and scannable.
Convert the 5-feature grid into a single-column stack. Keep the label, headline, and description above the cards. Retain the section CTA as a full-width button below the cards.
Mirror Seedream on mobile with a single-column feature stack. Preserve the section hierarchy and keep generous vertical spacing between cards.
Stack pricing cards vertically. Keep the price emphasis on Seedance and quote-led layout for Seedream. Ensure the CTA buttons are full-width and stacked. Do not add price values where missing.

Render testimonials as a single-column stack. Keep star rating, italic quote, bold author, and grey designation. Consider a vertically scrollable stack only if frame constraints require it, but prefer standard stacked cards.

sections.variantHint: mobile-friendly publication list or omit if no items
sections.notes: Because there are no news items, omit on mobile unless a shell is required by the page template. If included, use a compact stacked list with title and subtitle only.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use a marketing/default typography pairing: Sora for headings and Inter for body copy.
Keep the hero as a branded full-width band with white text on a strong primary background; do not use a white hero.
Use one consistent feature card component across both product sections; only content and iconography/state change.
Seedream and Seedance should be visually parallel sections to reinforce product family clarity.
Pricing should be quote-oriented for Seedream and price-led for Seedance; do not fabricate missing prices or discounts.
Because trust badges are absent in the input, do not create a standalone trust strip; rely on hero, pricing, and testimonials for trust.
News is empty in the source data; omit the section in the final Figma build unless a template placeholder is explicitly needed.
Mobile should strictly stack all sections with full-width buttons and single-column cards.
Do not introduce extra form or awards sections since the source content does not support them.

This section should be omitted or rendered as a minimal spacer because include is false and no points are provided. If the page template requires it, use a subtle three-card utility grid with generic support messaging only, without creating a strong visual emphasis.

Keep the card treatment simple with clear inclusions, a strong CTA, and no clutter.

Use a carousel because there are five testimonials. Keep it editorial and concise, with one featured quote at a time and supporting author details beneath. Add subtle category context through role labels like Creative Director, Video Producer, and Marketing Manager to reinforce relevance.

Since form fields are not defined, convert this into a conversion-oriented lead capture card using a simple request-demo layout. Place it on a white surface with soft elevation, a short reassurance line, and one dominant CTA. This should feel like the final handoff point after the testimonials.

No news items are provided, so keep this as a lightweight closing strip only if the template requires it. Use a muted horizontal marquee of capability phrases instead of publication logos, or omit visually if allowed.

features.alt: This video presents a calm and peaceful indoor setting, bathed in the warm glow of a sunset. The overall mood is serene and comfortable, with a static activity level. The visual style is pixel art, reminiscent of retro video games, giving it an artistic and nostalgic aesthetic. The room features a bookshelf filled with books, various potted plants, and a comfortable-looking armchair with a cute cat-face pillow. Sunlight streams through a large window, creating bright, warm-toned light patterns on the wooden floor. The color palette is dominated by oranges, yellows, and browns, with touches of green from the plants, creating a high-saturation, inviting atmosphere. tw-object-cover

This image depicts a dynamic, high-energy scene of a modern train traversing diverse weather conditions, representing four distinct seasons. The overall mood is dramatic and visually striking, showcasing the train's resilience. The setting is outdoor, featuring mountainous landscapes in various states: snowy peaks, barren rocks, and hazy desert. The visual style is realistic with a touch of artistic exaggeration to highlight the extreme weather. The emotional tone is powerful and adventurous, emphasizing journey and endurance. The central subject is a sleek, white and blue passenger train. The artistic style is photorealistic, with clear details in the train and surrounding environment. The color characteristics are highly saturated and varied, transitioning from cool blues and whites in the winter storm to warm oranges and yellows in the sunny and dusty desert scenes. The color palette shifts from blue and white to warm orange, yellow, and earthy brown tones. tw-object-cover

This video features a mysterious, sleek gray mannequin-like figure holding up a digital scoreboard at a sports stadium. The mood is calm and slightly surreal, with a bright, outdoor setting under a clear sky. The activity level is static, focusing on the mannequin and the scoreboard. The visual style is modern and realistic, with a subtle artistic touch due to the mannequin's appearance. The emotional tone is neutral, perhaps slightly intriguing. The main subject is the mannequin, dressed in a striped shirt, holding a black digital scoreboard displaying "11:22" in red LED lights. The background shows blurred stadium seating filled with an audience, suggesting a sporting event. The artistic style leans towards photorealism with a high-tech element. The color characteristics are cool tones, primarily grays, blues, and whites, with vibrant red highlights from the scoreboard. The color palette consists mainly of cool grays, light blue, and bright red. tw-object-cover

This video depicts a bright, calm, and spacious indoor setting of a modern minimalist smart home. The atmosphere is peaceful and serene, with a static camera view showcasing the interior design. The visual style is realistic and contemporary, emphasizing clean lines and understated elegance. Key elements include a large living area with a sofa, a sleek kitchen island with a sink, a fireplace with active flames, and a wall-mounted smart display showing various controls. The color characteristics are warm tones, dominated by muted pastels and earthy neutrals like beige, cream, and light wood, with subtle orange highlights from the sun and fireplace. The overall color palette is light and inviting, creating a sense of comfort and sophistication. tw-object-cover

This video features a bright and whimsical scene with a cheerful, fantastical atmosphere. The setting is an outdoor, natural environment, depicting a vibrant green hill under a clear blue sky with soft, wispy clouds. The activity level is static, focusing on a single, charming subject. The visual style is highly artistic and illustrative, reminiscent of a cartoon or children's book, with a touch of photorealism in the textures. The emotional tone is peaceful, joyful, and imaginative. The main subject is an adorable, round house shaped like a donut, complete with pink icing, colorful sprinkles, and a chimney made of stacked donuts, emitting a wisp of smoke. The windows and door are adorned with colorful candies, and warm light glows from within. The color characteristics are predominantly warm and pastel, with high saturation, creating a sweet and inviting palette of blues, greens, pinks, and various candy colors. tw-object-cover
